```artifact
Feature: Hospital Services Coordination

  Scenario: Coordination of activities in the Software Engineering process
    Given the system is initialized
    When an activity is requested
    Then the system should coordinate the activity

  Scenario: Guidance by Prof. Chandrasekaran and esteemed staff
    Given Prof. Chandrasekaran is available
    When a request is made
    Then the system should be guided by Prof. Chandrasekaran

  Scenario Outline: Providing quality medicines via authorized Chemists
    Given the system is initialized
    When a patient requests quality medicines
    And the Chemist is authorized
    Then the system should provide the medicines at discounted prices
    Examples:
      | patient | Chemist | authorized |
      | Patient1| Chemist1| true       |
      | Patient2| Chemist2| false      |

  Scenario Outline: Providing door-step Laboratory services
    Given the system is initialized
    When a patient requests laboratory services
    And the Chemist is authorized
    Then the system should provide door-step Laboratory services
    Examples:
      | patient | Chemist | authorized |
      | Patient1| Chemist1| true       |
      | Patient2| Chemist2| false      |

  Scenario: Handling unavailable Prof. Chandrasekaran
    Given Prof. Chandrasekaran is unavailable
    When a request is made
    Then the system should notify the patient of the unavailability
```
